parameters.name: adapter_id
parameters.constraint: matches exactly one adapter in an ADR 0183 admitted adapter-read environment

parameters.name: mode
parameters.constraint: equals the adapter's current config_state; returns unchanged

parameters.name: mode
parameters.constraint: differs from current config_state; changing adapter mode is unavailable

parameters.name: boot_mode
parameters.constraint: norm, dd, ds, of or sms
